resources.string: What\'s playing, with pause and skip; shows while something plays
Show while something is playing, and for %1$s after it pauses

Android shares the title, artist and artwork only with apps that have notification access. BentoBar tells Android to send it no notifications at all; it reads only what your media players say is playing, and keeps that on this device.
Switch grayed out? Tap it, tap OK, then turn on Allow restricted settings in App info.
